anns.ann: Patients with two copies of the CYP2C9*46 allele or one copy of the *46 allele in combination with a no function allele may have decreased metabolism of diclofenac as compared to individuals with two normal function alleles. This drug-variant pair has been assigned a “no recommendation” by CPIC, as it was determined to be not clinically actionable. This annotation only covers the pharmacokinetic relationship between CYP2C9 and diclofenac and does not include evidence about clinical outcomes. Other genetic and clinical factors may also influence metabolism of diclofenac.
